claim: A status record with only 'blocked: yes/no' hides waiting lanes.

metric.what: Status files whose 'doing' line says waiting, standing by or parked while 'blocked' says no, at one moment.

countedFrom.machine: one Windows 11 machine; one master, 8 orchestrators, about 50 short-lived workers, one person
versions: agent harness as installed in the period (exact version not recorded)

proposedChange: Add a 'waiting: <on whom> - <what ends it>' line, separate from blocked, and keep status history. This is also the precondition for measuring who waits on whom.
whyItGeneralises: A two-state status field cannot express waiting on any fleet; the gap is in the record format, not in this fleet's habits.
